title: Garry Nolan has seen little people and a craft

tellings.quote: he he has seen some little people. >> He's seen >> Yeah. And he's seen a craft, too.

plain: A man named Garry Nolan, whose story is placed at Stanford, California, has seen some little people and has also seen a craft. That is what Jesse Michels says Nolan told him, and he passes it on second-hand without giving any detail of when or where. If true, it would mean Nolan saw both the beings and their vehicle himself.
